mentions.name: Jetson-based toxic emissions monitor
mentions.description: A low-cost system for monitoring toxic emissions at the local Tata Steel plant, migrating from Modal to a single Nvidia Jetson while keeping the setup as cheap as possible but still accurate; run pro bono for the last two years.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on migration from Modal to a single nvidia jetson, to do low-cost monitoring of toxic emissions at the local tata steel plant. Ran this pro bono for the last 2 years, the fun is in getting this as cheap as possible but still with good accuracy
